identity.flat_master_role: visual identity reference and standalone fallback only
identity.recipe_key: stable IDs, never array positions at runtime

contract.native_attachment_rule: Author every attachment at its final occupied pixel size on a 128x128 transparent canvas; never resize the standalone native128 master at runtime or during asset production.

occlusion.back: draw behind the avatar base without clearing avatar pixels
occlusion.chest: clip badge pixels to the final garment alpha mask
occlusion.face: overlay face details; no implicit alpha clearing
occlusion.foreground: draw last and do not mutate avatar alpha
occlusion.garment: replace only the authored torso garment mask; never clear neck or head
occlusion.hand: draw held item above the body; use an authored grip mask for fingers
occlusion.headwear: draw above hair; clear hair only through an authored binary occlusion mask
